newsitem.title: USA: Muni sales total $3.2 bln for week of Jan 13.
newsitem.headline: Muni sales total $3.2 bln for week of Jan 13.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales for the week of Jan 13 are expected to total $3.2 billion in 105 offerings, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $987 million million in 64 sales. The largest is a $195 million North Carolina revenue bond deal on Wednesday.
Negotiated sales total $2.2 billion in 41 offerings. The largest is a $550 million New York City general obligation deal through Goldman Sachs & Co.

An additional $538 million of deals are on the possible list, meaning underwriters have said they may price the deal sometime next week depending on market conditions. --U.S. Municipal Information Group, 212-859-1826
